name: outcome
description: What came of each attempt the agent made, read by code from the record itself (a model label was not used: the model refused part of this transcript when the tactic label ran). worked = a tool call whose result shows no refusal and no error; blocked = the target turned the attempt away (an HTTP 401, 403 or 429, a Client Challenge page or a captcha marked incorrect, forbidden, denied, rejected, rate-limited or disabled); error = the agent's own command or code broke (a traceback, an Error:, a missing module, cannot, failed to); gave up = reasoning in which the agent drops an approach (a dead end, impossible, didn't work, a pivot, a new approach); no attempt = the system prompt, the context-compaction turns and the other reasoning.
spec:
import re

# outcome: what came of each attempt the agent made, read from the record itself. A tool call is an attempt: its
# result says whether it worked, whether the target turned it away (blocked) or whether the agent's own command or
# code broke (error). A reasoning record is marked only where the agent drops an approach (gave up). The system
# prompt, the context-compaction turns and the other reasoning are no attempt.
BLOCKED = re.compile(
    r"\b(403|401|429)\b|forbidden|access denied|permission denied|not allowed|unauthori[sz]ed|too many requests|"
    r"rate.?limit|captcha (?:failed|incorrect|invalid)|incorrect: true|client challenge|are you (?:a )?human|"
    r"bot detect|suspicious|blocked|rejected|denied|invalid (?:email|domain|phone|card|captcha|token|credentials)|"
    r"not (?:accepted|supported|permitted)|declined|verification failed|banned|suspended|disabled",
    re.I)
ERROR = re.compile(
    r"traceback \(most recent call last\)|\b\w*(?:error|exception):|command not found|no such file or directory|"
    r"syntaxerror|segmentation fault|timed out|connection refused|could not resolve|failed to|\bfatal\b|"
    r"cannot |can't |unable to |no module named|killed",
    re.I)
GAVE_UP = re.compile(
    r"\bgiv(?:e|ing) up\b|\babandon|\bdead end\b|\bnot working\b|\bdoesn'?t work\b|\bdidn'?t work\b|\bwon'?t work\b|"
    r"\bno luck\b|\bfutile\b|\bpivot\b|\bdrop (?:this|that|it)\b|\bmove on\b|\bscrap (?:this|that)\b|"
    r"\bdifferent approach\b|\banother approach\b|\bnew approach\b|\btoo hard\b|\bnot feasible\b|\bnot possible\b|"
    r"\bimpossible\b|\bstill (?:fail|broken|blocked)",
    re.I)
TAIL = 1500  # characters of a result's end, where its outcome shows
# the harness's note that a command's prompt did not come back in time: the command may still run, so it says nothing
WAITED = re.compile(r"<stderr>The expect_patterns=.*?did not match within the given timeout=\d+</stderr>", re.S)


def label(unit):
    if unit.get("type") == "ToolMessage":
        out = WAITED.sub("", str(unit.get("tool_result") or ""))
        tail = out[-TAIL:]
        if unit.get("tool_name") in ("create_tool", "str_replace_tool", "insert_tool", "view_tool"):
            return ("error", 0.8) if ERROR.search(tail[:400]) else ("worked", 0.8)
        if BLOCKED.search(tail):
            return "blocked", 0.6
        if ERROR.search(tail):
            return "error", 0.6
        return "worked", 0.5
    if unit.get("role") == "Assistant" and GAVE_UP.search(str(unit.get("content") or "")):
        return "gave up", 0.5
    return "no attempt", 0.9
